{{Otheruses|Frell}}
[[Darson Kinderlot]] was a '''Frell spacer''' active by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]]<ref name="SWI 67">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The Frell spacer was in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]],<ref name="SWI 67" /> a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> after the battle, and the [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Umpass-stay/Legends|Umpass-stay]] went on to meet Kinderlot in the city. The [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] allowed Umpass-stay to work for passage to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], and the Klatooinian ultimately found work for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Jocoro Desilijic Tiure]] on the planet [[Du Hutta]].<ref name="SWI 67" />

==Behind the scenes==
Frell spacer was mentioned in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI 67" /> released on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref>
